proposed_capability: Extend the established human-owned desktop perimeter across every executable project surface and agent harness; distinguish early unnamed Bluetooth mouse appearance from authenticated endpoint identity; prevent game or capture failure from triggering any Windows repair or input interception.
player_save_control_impact: No game, user save, Windows service, Bluetooth radio, HID pairing, driver, keyboard, Print Screen or host settings will be changed; all operator-owned channels remain sovereign.
expected_outcome: Machine contract and ontology classify distinct recovery and endpoint evidence states; wider source scanner blocks service, PnP, pairing and input mutation across future launchers/workflows/agent adapters; adversarial fixtures prevent false regression passes.
negative_tests: New root-level executable OS peripheral repair fails even when outside scripts/betterinstincts
New Cursor hook, workflow YAML, and launcher attempting peripheral mutation fail repository scan
Windows PairAsync/UnpairAsync and mouse-specific ambiguity cases are denied as autonomous effects
Read-only discovery and game capture remain permissible
Existing Cursor deny-by-default command hooks and human-screen admission remain unchanged
rollback_path: Revert this isolated feature branch or its merge commit; no live workstation modifications are performed.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact successful Mouse-to-ProtoArc endpoint transition is not captured; same endpoint rename vs replacement remains unresolved.
Paired and physically functional device does not prove which earlier service or driver failure caused the incident.
No evidence attributes a Windows peripheral mutation to a particular AI agent.
New SysAdminSuite guard event-delivery and M343 troubleshooting require separate host observations.
